nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database Integrity Principle
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL is the single source of truth for both Python and Go services. Foreign keys, cascade behaviors, and transaction consistency must be respected.

nodes.label: Hybrid Micro-Service Architecture
nodes.rationale: Split CPU-bound web serving and auth (Flask) from high-throughput real-time stateful connections (Go WebSocket) to maximize concurrency while maintaining fast developer velocity.

nodes.label: Separation of Concerns Principle
nodes.rationale: Flask handles HTTP routes, templates, standard REST APIs, and auth; Go server handles WebSocket connections and high-speed chat broadcasting on port 8080.

nodes.label: ADR-001: Polyglot Dual-Engine Architecture (Flask + Go)
nodes.rationale: Split into Python Flask (Port 5000) for standard page rendering/auth and Go (Port 8080) utilizing gorilla/websocket for low-latency, high-throughput chat rooms and presence monitoring to easily manage 10,000+ concurrent connections without GIL starvation.

nodes.label: ADR-002: Direct PostgreSQL Shared State
nodes.rationale: Connect both Flask and Go directly to the shared PostgreSQL database to minimize latency during real-time message persistence rather than routing chat storage requests through Flask HTTP endpoints.

nodes.label: OAuth Dual-Server Redirect Architecture
nodes.rationale: Flask (5000) serves authorized JS origins while Go (8080) handles the OAuth callback /auth/google/callback for rapid token exchange and validation.

nodes.label: ERR-001: Missing psycopg2 Wheel on Python 3.14
nodes.norm_label: err-001: missing psycopg2 wheel on python 3.14
nodes.rationale: Arch Linux system default Python 3.14 lacked pre-built binary wheels for psycopg2-binary, resolved by pinning virtualenv to Python 3.12 via uv.

nodes.label: ERR-002: Missing Go Executable on System Path
nodes.norm_label: err-002: missing go executable on system path
nodes.rationale: Go 1.22.5 installed in user space was missing from PATH, resolved by creating symlinks in ~/.local/bin.

nodes.label: ADR-003: Python 3.12 Virtual Environment via uv
nodes.norm_label: adr-003: python 3.12 virtual environment via uv
nodes.rationale: System default Python is 3.14 which lacks pre-built binary wheels for psycopg2-binary, causing compilation errors without pg_config. Pinning to Python 3.12 managed via uv ensures pre-built binary wheels, fast builds, and guaranteed stability.
